sections.headline: JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo's priority is a Reality Gap in how a distinctive part of the proposition is represented in AI answers.
sections.keyInsight: Urban Luxury is recognized in only 0.6% of monitored answers. That is low enough to matter commercially if the attribute is part of how the hotel should win relevant traveler needs. Renaissance Santo Domingo Jaragua Hotel & Casino also appears in related absent scenarios, which can compound the representation miss. Broader Scenario Presence (98.4%) and Consideration (71.4%) do not, by themselves, prove the distinctive attribute is traveling into answers.
sections.whyItMatters: If distinctive property attributes are weakly represented, the hotel can look broadly visible while still losing the moments where its real proposition should matter. This is a representation problem first, not automatically a peer-competition program.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on Urban Luxury. Verify first-party and major travel-source completeness for that attribute before treating the issue as a peer-competition problem. Confirm the attribute is stated clearly where AI systems are most likely to read it.
sections.whatToReview: Open Reality Gap evidence for Urban Luxury and compare recognition cues with official property pages and high-authority travel sources. Then check a small set of related demand scenarios for whether the attribute appears when competitors are named.
